purpose: Start the frozen independent proxy shadow after the M7B PASS without changing the formulas, then compare future proxy signals with newly arriving genuine Webhook/SQLite alerts.

local_inputs.mt5_files_root: Read from MT5_FILES_ROOT in the existing local Mochipoyo .env.

first_run.instruction: Pull feature/mochipoyo-alert-research, open scripts/mochipoyo_alert_research, and double-click run_build_m7c_prospective_shadow_once.bat. Upload or paste the console result before relying on the forever loop.
first_run.safety: The first run may refresh only M3/M4 derived tables when new raw alerts make them stale. It does not change raw alerts, CSVs, formulas, Discord, MT5 orders, entry gate, live-ready, or final signal.

continuous_run.collector: Keep the existing scripts/mochipoyo_alert_research/run_collect_events_cloudflare_forever.bat process running. Do not start a second collector if it is already running.
continuous_run.m7c_monitor: After the one-shot bootstrap passes, double-click scripts/mochipoyo_alert_research/run_m7c_prospective_shadow_forever.bat in a separate window.
continuous_run.lock_policy: Only one M7C shadow loop may run. A second instance fails closed.

frozen_proxy.PRIMARY_LONG: KERNEL-L1: IDLE AND rci9_turn_up AND BULLISH_STACK
frozen_proxy.PRIMARY_SHORT: KERNEL-S1: IDLE AND rci9_turn_down AND BEARISH_STACK

review_schedule.operational_checkpoint: Review when 5 supported new source events have been scored.
review_schedule.interim_checkpoint: Review when 15 supported new source events have been scored.

important_interpretation: M7C is the first independent forward reproduction test. Until forward events are scored, the proprietary alert formula has not been reproduced. Even after the formal count gate is reached, the program only marks the sample ready for manual review.
prohibited_actions: Do not change the frozen M7C formulas, thresholds, EMA stack conditions, bootstrap, start time, matching window, grace period, or review gates after seeing forward results.
Do not score M7C decisions at or before prospective_start_utc.
Do not use current M15 high, low, or close.
Do not use returns, MFE, MAE, win/loss, source EXIT profit, PF, or future outcomes.
Do not freeze or score REENTRY rules.
Do not historical-scan or extract other timeframes.
Do not claim the proprietary internal formula has been reconstructed.
Do not enable entry gate, Discord, MT5 orders, live-ready, or final signal.
